---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? What's the use case? (Describe the need,
not just a proposed solution.)

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. API sketches welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why they fall short.

## Scope check (v1 non-goals)

The following are **out of scope for v1** (see [PRD §3](../../PRD.md)). Please
confirm your request isn't one of these (or explain why it should be
reconsidered):

- [ ] My request is **not** real-time collaboration.
- [ ] My request is **not** conditional logic / loops in personalization
      (v1 is basic `{{variable}}` merge tags only).
- [ ] My request does **not** require a bundled backend / hosting service.
- [ ] My request is **not** "Fill" (locked content-only) mode (that's v2).
- [ ] My request does **not** require legacy-browser support for the *editor*
      (evergreen only; exported email still targets Outlook via MJML).

## Additional context

Mockups, links, prior art, etc.
